sentences.text: Scientists estimated that this dinosaur measured 15 meters in length and weighed 5 metric tons.
Remains were recovered during fieldwork between 1999 and 2000 and officially named by Harris and Dodson in 2004.
Initial descriptions placed it in Flagellicaudata incertae sedis because it showed mixed primitive and derived traits.
Later research reclassified it as a North American dicraeosaurid, moving it from the subfamily Apatosaurinae.
Its time range spans from the Kimmeridgian to the Tithonian stages, between 154.8 and 143.1 million years ago.
It inhabited the Morrison Formation in southern Carbon County, Montana, USA.
